notes_en: Five new games: three more Master System titles and two Atari 2600 originals join the library. The gamepad is cleaner too - no Fast/Slow buttons, and the menu button now sits between Select and Start.
notes_vi: Thêm 5 game mới: 3 game Master System và 2 game gốc Atari 2600. Tay cầm cũng gọn hơn - bỏ nút Fast/Slow, nút menu nằm giữa Select và Start.
